chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir.

He said: I was sitting with Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) when Zayd ibn Ali (peace be upon him) came forward. When Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) looked at him as he was approaching, he said: 'This is a master from his Ahl al-Bayt, and the seeker of their vengeance. Truly noble is the mother who gave birth to you, O Zayd!'

key_terms.أَنْجَبَتْ: A verb meaning 'to produce a noble child'; the expression 'truly noble is the mother who gave birth to you' is a classical Arabic form of high praise
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ: His household, referring to the Prophet's family (Ahl al-Bayt) — specifically here to the household of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.أَوْتَارِهِمْ: Blood debts or vengeance; in classical Arabic, 'al-witar' refers to the duty of blood revenge. Here it signifies Zayd's role as the one who would seek justice for the martyrdom of the Imams.
key_terms.سَيِّدٌ: Master, lord, or chief; also a title for descendants of the Prophet. Here it affirms Zayd's noble status within the Ahl al-Bayt.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about Zayd ibn Ali?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) praised his brother Zayd ibn Ali (AS) when the latter entered, declaring him a noble master of the Ahl al-Bayt and one who would seek retribution for the blood of the martyred Imams. This account, narrated through Abu al-Jarud who was personally present, serves as a historical validation of Zayd's uprising against the Umayyad oppressors, despite the theological differences between Zaydis and Twelver Shia. The praise 'truly noble is the mother who gave birth to you' is a traditional Arabic expression of high admiration for someone's character and lineage.
word_analysis: has given birth to a noble child

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab from al-Husayn b. `Ilwan from `Amr b. Khalid from Abi’l Jarud Zayd b. al-Mundhir.

He said: I was sitting with Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as) when Zayd b. `Ali (as) came forward. When Abu Ja`far (as) looked to him as he came, he said: This is a master (sayyid) from his Ahl al-Bayt and the seeker of their vengeance. Your mother has given birth to a pure son, Zayd.
